variants.headline: {{civilization}} enters the {{era}}
body: {{civilization}}, a friend of our nation, has passed out of the {{former}} and into the {{era}}.

variants.headline: A friendly nation enters the {{era}}
body: A friend of our nation has passed out of the {{former}} and into the {{era}}. The name has not reached our records.

variants.headline: A friend crosses into the {{era}}
body: We are informed that {{civilization}}, a friendly power, has lately left the {{former}} for the {{era}}. A friend's progress is welcome news in any age.

variants.headline: A new age in {{civilization}}, they say
body: The traders say the roads out of {{civilization}} smell of fresh ink this season. Our friend has crossed into the {{era}}, and the story came with the first travelers.

variants.headline: Of {{civilization}}'s entry into the {{era}}
body: In this season {{civilization}}, whose nearest city lies {{distance}} tiles from our own, passed out of the {{former}} and into the {{era}}. The record notes the change and holds it without comment.

variants.headline: What a friend's new era means
body: A nation does not move from the {{former}} to the {{era}} in a season; the crossing is the work of years. A friend standing in a new age is a friend with more to trade, more to teach and more to lean on.

variants.headline: {{team}} gains {{tech}}
body: {{team}}, a nearby power, has gained {{tech}}, according to reports from the border. Its cities lie close to our own.

variants.headline: {{team}} gain {{tech}}
body: {{team}}, nearby powers acting as one team, have gained {{tech}}, according to reports from the border. Their cities lie close to our own.

variants.headline: A neighbor's new learning
body: What a neighbor knows changes what a neighbor can do. {{tech}} now sits in the hands of {{team}}, a team whose lands run near ours. The ledger of the age has a new entry, and it is not in our handwriting.

variants.headline: Notice to the learned: {{tech}} abroad
body: We are informed that {{tech}} is now held by {{team}}, a team with cities close to our own. The fact is reported as it reached the printer.

variants.headline: New learning across the fence
body: At the border stalls they were asking what {{tech}} does. Nobody could say, but everyone agreed it belonged to {{team}} now, and the fence has never once stopped a rumor.

variants.headline: The lamp next door
body: Next door the lamp burns bright and late. {{tech}} is the word at our gate.

variants.headline: Our nation enters the {{era}}
body: The chronicles will mark this season: we have left the old age behind and entered the {{era}}.

variants.headline: Hear it! The {{era}} is ours
body: Hear it, people! Our nation has entered the {{era}}. Say it in the streets and say it again: the {{era}} is ours.

variants.headline: We enter the {{era}}
body: Here is the news: our nation has entered the {{era}}. The old age is over. The new one starts now.

variants.headline: The record of our passage into the {{era}}
body: In this year providence carried our nation out of the former age and into the {{era}}. The scribes set it down with thanks, and the shrines will do the same.

variants.headline: The bells rang all morning
body: Madam Editor, the bells rang all morning for our entry into the {{era}}. Ages do not arrive by accident; they are built, and the men who built this one deserve the city's thanks. I have sent mine.

variants.headline: Our nation gains {{tech}}
body: {{tech}} is now counted among the knowledge of our team. The record of what our people know grows by one name.

variants.headline: {{tech}}: measured and gained
body: Our team has gained {{tech}}, and the measured sum of what this nation knows has risen by one. Credit belongs to the scholars and their method, kept through seasons when no one was watching: no omen ever finished a study.

variants.headline: One more for the home team
body: We just gained {{tech}}. That's the nation's count of technologies up again. You love to see it.

variants.headline: Notice: our team gains {{tech}}
body: We are informed that {{tech}} is now counted among the knowledge of our team. The {{era}} continues what earlier ages began, one name at a time.

variants.headline: At the market, the word is {{tech}}
body: They asked at the stalls what {{tech}} does. The best answer anyone gave was that it is ours, and at the market that was answer enough.

variants.headline: {{civilization}} crosses into the {{era}}
body: {{civilization}}, neither our friend nor our ally, has passed out of the {{former}} and into the {{era}}.

variants.headline: A rival power enters the {{era}}
body: A power that is neither our friend nor our ally has passed out of the {{former}} and into the {{era}}. The name has not reached our records.

variants.headline: A rival leaves the {{former}}
body: We are informed that {{civilization}}, no friend of ours, has lately passed from the {{former}} into the {{era}}. The news is set down as it arrived, neither better nor worse for the telling.

variants.headline: Up the road, a new era
body: {{civilization}} has crossed into the {{era}}, and its nearest city stands {{distance}} tiles from ours. The border has not moved, but the country behind it just did.

variants.headline: It is told of {{civilization}}
body: It is told that in {{civilization}} the old calendars were not thrown away but shelved, and the new count begins with the {{era}}. What the old age cost them, the tellers do not say.

variants.headline: A rival enters the {{era}}. And us?
body: Citizens! {{civilization}} has entered the {{era}}. Every age is paid for somewhere, with coin, study or toil. Let the ministers say what we are paying, and for which age.

variants.headline: {{civilization}} now stands first in technologies
body: No nation counts more technologies than {{civilization}}, which now holds {{count}} of them. A season past, others stood ahead of it.

variants.headline: A new nation stands first in technologies
body: No nation counts more technologies than the new front-runner, which now holds {{count}} of them. A season past, others stood ahead. The name has not reached our records.

variants.headline: The technologies count, restated
body: Nation at the front: {{civilization}}
Technologies held: {{count}}
Nations counted ahead of it: none

variants.headline: First place, shared
body: {{civilization}} tops the technologies count at {{count}}. So does somebody else. The podium was built for one.

variants.headline: What the front of the count means
body: The technologies count is a blunt instrument; it weighs a nation's learning by number, not by use. Still, the power now standing first, with {{count}} technologies, has done reading that others put off. The count will be argued over. The reading will not.
